coordinates: Pixels; origin at top-left of each cell; x rightward, y downward.
anchor_status: Initial visual estimates; calibrate once against original pet frames before reuse. Generated views do not share an identical ankle position.

views.name: side_right
views.use: Right-facing grounded feet; dragon and squirrel.

views.name: seated_sole
views.use: Seated hind feet tilted upward; panda. Mirror when needed for opposite seated foot.

rendering.placement: Place each view's ankle anchor at the pet foot attachment point. Store attachment position, view index, scale, rotation, layer, and visibility per pet animation frame.

limb_rules.dragon: Four ground-use feet in all 12 reference frames, allowing natural occlusion.
limb_rules.squirrel: Frames 1-9: four ground-use feet. Frames 10-12: two hind-foot shoes; two bare front paws hold acorn.
limb_rules.panda: Frames 1-5: four ground-use feet. Frame 6: one bare reaching front paw and three ground-use feet. Frames 7-12: two hind-foot shoes; two bare front paws handle bamboo. Preserve seated pose.

future_shoes: Retain this view order and cell dimensions. Match these ankle anchors and corresponding view scale, or supply updated per-view anchors. Keep original pets unchanged; equip footwear as separate layers.
integration_status: Art atlas and template metadata only; pet attachment tracks and runtime rendering are not implemented.
